page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 16-vCPU Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 128.0 GB of memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring cloud block storage for operating system volumes and data persistence. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

By delivering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the hardware configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-constrained workloads without requiring excessive core counts. Appropriate workload fits include in-memory databases, large caching layers, distributed data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise software deployments.
